title: Bind the Venus2.0 backend handoff to the selected Venus_3 RTL three-bit task-input descriptor

unchanged_conservative_policy.reason: The CCH DAG uses only logical types 0, 1, and 2. Pointer-type semantics 4, 5, and 6 remain blocked until separately qualified.

authoritative_rtl.fact: TASK_INPUT_TYPE_NUM is 8 and TASK_INPUT_TYPE_BITS is $clog2(8), therefore the physical descriptor field is three bits.

workload_impact: No C task, BAS DAG, golden, Scheduler core, Gem5 semantic, or RTL source change is needed.
required_regression_after_approval: Rerun the integrated CCH Gem5 verification under the approved manifest.
Rebuild exact Scheduler firmware and require the expected l1.bin digest.
Create a new isolated RTL snapshot with snapshot-only file-list relocation.
Perform a fresh VCS compile and compare all 18 visible RTL outputs.
rollback: Change abi.task_input_descriptor.physical_type_bits from 3 back to 2. No generated firmware or evidence is promoted automatically.
